name: Ace Attorney: The Final Trials
summary:
The Wright Anything Agency is back! Ace Attorney: The Final Trials is a fan game that takes place around half a year after Spirit of Justice.It acts as a sequel to the game, while also wrapping the series into a satisfying conclusion, and showing the rebirth of a new era for Phoenix Wright. Old and new faces alike will make an appearance in the Final Trials, and the Agency must face threats and dilemmas never seen before, including an underground organization scheming something very dubious....
This game will contain spoilers for every previous installment in the franchise, including the Investigations series. I do not own or hold any stake in the series, and this work is fully unofficial.
